title: One ship froze world trade
hook_variants: One ship got stuck. Nine billion dollars of trade stopped. Every day.
In 2021 a single ship parked sideways and broke the world.
This is the most expensive parking job in history.

scenes.say: One ship got stuck, and the world lost billions a day.
March twenty twenty-one. The Ever Given turns sideways in the Suez Canal.
Asia to Europe. The shortcut is Suez. Without it, ships go all the way around Africa.
Six days blocked. Around nine point six billion dollars of trade held up every single day.
scenes.label: TRADE HELD UP PER DAY

scenes.say: Hundreds of ships queued. Deliveries slipped for weeks. Prices jumped.
The whole world runs through a few narrow chokepoints.
Follow Landed Costs for how the world really moves.

caption:
The Ever Given blocked the Suez Canal for 6 days in 2021, holding up an estimated $9.6B of trade PER DAY. 🚢😳
